Header: Conogethes punctiferalis castor capsule borer Ye zinijibil ginid borbuware tebai የየየየየየ የየየ የየየየ የየየ in Amharic language

Prevention: Use a repellent plant such as
Lantana camara as mulch by drying and chopping at the time of planting to reduce the infection by shoot borer
Vitex negundo leaves 2t/acre at 40 and 90 days after planting

Enhance natural enemies like larval parasitoids ( Bracon brevicornis ), predators (Ladybird beetle), and larval and pupal parasitoids ( Xanthopimpla sp.) by planting attractant flowering plants like sunflower, alfalfa and coriander around the field
Monitoring: Look for adult moths which are pale straw yellow with numerous small black spots and a wing span of 18 to 24 mm
For early detection of the larvae, monitor from shoot growth until harvesting since the species breeds throughout the year.
When the temperature and humidity is high, monitor daily because this is when the pest is most active
Look for the 1-2 cm young larvae with a black head and a pale greenish body on the green contents of the leaves

Consider direct control methods before the presence of a bore-hole on the stem through which excreta of insects (frass) come out and before dried and yellowed central shoots are found and when control is too late
Direct Control: Trichogramma chilonis at 40000/ acre to the ginger field to parasitize and kill the eggs of the pest.
Release when adult moths are seen in the field
Cut open the shoot and pick out the caterpillar and destroy
Prune and destroy freshly infested stems by burning or burying
Continually assess natural enemies which help in reduction of pest populations throughout the season
Restrictions: All protective measures mentioned in green control are usually enough to control this pest
